title: Slovakian Zucchini Fritters
description: A traditional Slovakian dish made with zucchini and served with a side of zesty sauce.
instructions: Grate the zucchini and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, egg, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the chopped basil to the bowl and mix well.
Add the grated zucchini to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop the zucchini mixture into the skillet, forming patties.
Cook the fritters for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Serve the fritters hot with a side of zesty sauce.
